title: Atlas review queue
description: content/review-queue.json. Single writer: scripts/atlas_world_web/review_queue.py (locked read-modify-write, atomic replace). `proposals`, `playerScaleAnchor` and `agentEditLog` belong to the observatory's Review Gate Inbox; unknown top-level keys are preserved on every write, so additionalProperties stays true.

verdicts.description: Keyed by asset-storybook key (e.g. mob:aggressive). A verdict is a work order for the art pipeline, so the note is mandatory.

source.description: `assets` for the asset verdict UI, or `proposal:<id>` when a Review Gate Inbox reject resolved an asset-keyed proposal.

workOrders.description: Append-only queue. Ids are server-assigned `wo-NNNN` (max existing + 1); a repeated `clientId` is a no-op. Legacy ids from before the merge (`wo-001`, `wo-<brief>-<cell>-<ms>-<seq>`) remain valid.
